recommendations.title: Buy San Antonio Spurs -5.5
recommendations.matchup: New York Knicks at San Antonio Spurs
recommendations.reason: Recommendation: buy San Antonio Spurs -5.5 at home. The no-vig spread market gives them about a 50% chance to cover, and after our home-court and bucket adjustments we land near 54%. Priced at -108, that works out to roughly +4.1% expected value per dollar, so the side clears our minimum-edge filter.
